report_name: Stealthy "SLEEPWALKER" Backdoor Waits for Magic Packet to Strike

attack_patterns.name: DLL Side-Loading
attack_patterns.description: The SLEEPWALKER backdoor, disguised as dpapi.dll, is placed in the ESET Management Agent directory to be loaded by the legitimate ERAAgent.exe process, achieving persistence and execution.

attack_patterns.name: Network Sniffing
attack_patterns.description: SLEEPWALKER uses a raw socket to passively sniff all network traffic on all interfaces, searching for a specific encrypted 'magic packet' to trigger its execution.

attack_patterns.name: Execution Guardrails
attack_patterns.description: The malware checks if its host process name is ERAAgent.exe before it begins its main function, remaining completely inactive otherwise to evade analysis and ensure it runs in the intended target process.

attack_patterns.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
attack_patterns.description: The backdoor's payload is decrypted using AES-256-CCM and is executed as a program written in a custom bytecode language with 23 instructions, obfuscating the attacker's commands and intent.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: The custom bytecode language used by SLEEPWALKER supports staged file delivery with SHA-256 integrity checks, allowing the attacker to transfer additional tools or payloads to the compromised host after activation.

attack_patterns.name: Native API
attack_patterns.description: The malware uses low-level APIs to create a raw socket for passive network sniffing, which helps it evade higher-level network monitoring tools.

malware.name: SLEEPWALKER
malware.description: A highly sophisticated and evasive Windows backdoor that remains dormant in memory, passively sniffing network traffic until activated by a specific 'magic packet'. Once active, it executes a payload written in a custom bytecode language.

identities.name: ESET
identities.description: The vendor of the ESET Management Agent (ERAAgent.exe), which was the targeted host process for the SLEEPWALKER backdoor's DLL side-loading persistence mechanism.

infrastructure.name: SLEEPWALKER Magic Packet Trigger
infrastructure.description: A specially crafted and encrypted network packet (e.g., TCP, UDP, or Ethernet frame) sent by the attacker to activate the dormant SLEEPWALKER backdoor by passively sniffing network traffic.

indicators.name: Anomalous SLEEPWALKER DLL
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Anomalous SLEEPWALKER DLL Found in ESET Directory
id: 9c1b3a8e-f4d2-4e1a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects the presence of 'dpapi.dll' in the ESET Remote Administrator Agent directory, which is a key indicator of the SLEEPWALKER backdoor.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/newly-sleepwalker-backdoor-waits-for.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-26
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains|all:
      - '\ESET\RemoteAdministrator\Agent\'
      - 'dpapi.dll'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the anomalous presence of dpapi.dll within the ESET Management Agent's installation directory, a specific indicator for the SLEEPWALKER backdoor.

indicators.name: SLEEPWALKER DLL Side-Loading via ERAAgent.exe
indicators.pattern:
title: SLEEPWALKER DLL Side-Loading via ERAAgent.exe
id: 8b2a9f7d-c6e5-4d3c-9a8b-7c6d5e4f3a2b
status: experimental
description: Detects the ESET Management Agent process (ERAAgent.exe) loading dpapi.dll from a non-system directory, a behavior associated with the SLEEPWALKER backdoor.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/newly-sleepwalker-backdoor-waits-for.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-26
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\ERAAgent.exe'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\dpapi.dll'
  filter:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects the specific DLL side-loading behavior of SLEEPWALKER where ERAAgent.exe loads a malicious dpapi.dll from its local directory.

indicators.name: Network Interface in Promiscuous Mode
indicators.pattern:
title: Network Interface in Promiscuous Mode
id: 7a1b8c6d-e5f4-4c3b-8a7b-6c5d4e3f2a1b
status: experimental
description: Detects when a network interface is put into promiscuous mode, which allows it to capture all traffic on the network segment. This is a behavior associated with passive sniffers like the SLEEPWALKER backdoor.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/newly-sleepwalker-backdoor-waits-for.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-26
tags:
  - attack.t1040
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 5152
    FilterInformation|contains: 'Promiscuous Mode'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects a network interface entering promiscuous mode, which is required for passive network sniffers like SLEEPWALKER to function.
